# AGENTS.md — 03-coffee-editorial

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Paper Moon**, specialty coffee, style "Warm paper editorial".
- Stack: Astro 7, Vanilla TS. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.ts` — all copy (EN + RU), menu, roast, brew steps
- `src/pages/index.astro` — page markup + small client script (lang, menu, timer)
- `src/components/Illo.astro` — line illustrations (add your own paths)
- `src/components/T.astro` — bilingual text helper
- `src/styles/global.css` — tokens at the top

## How to run
- `npm install          # Node 22.23+ (Astro 7)`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Menu whose rows draw a hand-made line illustration on hover + a working pour-over brew timer.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- No photos — illustrations are single-stroke SVG paths drawn with stroke-dashoffset.
- Terracotta marks only kickers, prices of attention and the last strokes of drawings.
- Section titles: small `Nº N` label + big Playfair title.
- Text in both languages is rendered by `<T>`; CSS shows one — never duplicate markup by hand.
- Hairline rules and double rules separate sections like a printed page.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
